defense_airdrop_system.mechanism: Capture and stay inside the area to accumulate defense progress across 3 stages
defense_airdrop_system.visibility: Progress tracked on all players' minimaps
defense_airdrop_system.rewards: Higher tier loot unlocked per completed stage

br_loadouts.bonfire: Get 3 Bonfires. Recovers 25 HP/s and 20 EP/s for 10s.
br_loadouts.supply_crate: Get 200 FF Coins, AK47, and 30 AR Ammo upon revival.
br_loadouts.armor_crate: Get Lv. 2 Vest, Lv. 2 Helmet, 2 Repair Kits, and 200 FF Coins at match start.
br_loadouts.scan: Reveals nearby enemies when parachuting and scans for 10s after landing.
br_loadouts.secret_clue: Displays resupply point during parachuting containing Grappling Hook Gun, Launch Pad, and 600 FF Coins.
br_loadouts.bounty_token: First elimination yields 480 FF Coins, random attachment, and Lv. 1 upgradable weapon.

cs_loadouts.supply_crate: Round 1: Katana; Round 2: Super Med; Round 3: Gloo Wall x2; Round 4: Upgradable chip; Round 5: Flash Freeze, Grenade, Gloo Wall; Round 6: Bonfire; Round 7: Vest Enlarger.
cs_loadouts.armor_crate: Restores 60% Vest and Helmet durability at round start.
cs_loadouts.scan: Marks all enemies for 3s when first safe zone shrinks.
cs_loadouts.bounty_token: Gain 300 extra CS Cash per elimination during first 90s of selected round.
cs_loadouts.secret_clue: Unlocks Secret Bazaar (500 Cash: Max EP, 600 Cash: 5 EP/s, 400 Cash: Med Kit, 2000 Cash: 20% team speed for 10s).
